title: PoE2 0.2.0h: Item Tier Filters, Jeweller's Orbs, Level 20 Gems and QoL
summary: 0.2.0h added the UnidentifiedItemTier filter property that 0.2.0g needed, raised Greater and Perfect Jeweller's Orb drops, made Level 20 Uncut Gems drop, and improved currency, stash and fast-travel QoL.
description: 0.2.0h explained: the UnidentifiedItemTier filter property, Jeweller's Orb changes, Level 20 Uncut Gems, stash transfers, Strongbox actions and what still applies in 0.5.4e.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Jeweller's Orbs and an item filter rules panel.

currentSummary: The UnidentifiedItemTier filter property introduced in 0.2.0h is still the correct way to show/hide tiered unidentified items in 0.5.4e.
Greater/Perfect Jeweller's Orb drop rates were raised in 0.2.0h but remain subject to later economy tuning.

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: 0.2.0h is the quality-of-life follow-up to the 0.2.0g loot rework. Its headline fix is the UnidentifiedItemTier filter property, which finally let filters distinguish high-tier unidentified items that 0.2.0g had made easy to hide by accident.

It also raised Greater and Perfect Jeweller's Orb drops, made Level 20 Uncut Skill and Spirit Gems drop, added quick currency-stack transfers, Ritual/Socketable stash-tab affinities, Strongbox and Essence quick actions, and improved shrine and town fast travel.

sections.title: Historical warning
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — the 0.2.0 era
paragraphs: 0.2.0h built directly on the 0.2.0g loot model. Filter syntax it introduced is still valid, but exact Orb drop weighting has moved with later economy patches.
bullets: 过滤器语法仍有效,掉率已被后续调整

items.title: Greater / Perfect Jeweller's Orb
items.detail: Drop rates were raised so players could more reliably roll socket numbers on gear, supporting the socketable and crafting systems introduced around 0.2.x.

items.title: Level 20 Uncut Skill / Spirit Gem
items.detail: These now drop, giving a direct path to high-level gems without relying solely on vendor or quest rewards.

sections.title: Stash and transfer impact
paragraphs: Quick currency-stack transfers and Ritual/Socketable stash-tab affinities reduced the busywork of moving loot between tabs during a mapping session.
Strongbox and Essence quick currency buttons cut the number of clicks needed to cash out rewards, which matters most in dense endgame farming.

items.question: Do I need to rewrite my filter after 0.2.0h?
answer: If your filter predates 0.2.0g/0.2.0h and only matches rarity, add UnidentifiedItemTier so you don't hide tiered unidentified items. Verify against the current client.

items.question: Are Perfect Jeweller's Orbs now common?
answer: Their drop rate was raised in 0.2.0h, but Orb economy has been tuned since, so treat current drop rates as subject to later patches.
